castle.bishop.name: Bishop Orsen
castle.bishop.tale.1: Peace, child of the forge. Our chapel keeps two bells. The day bell rings for work. The ember bell has been silent since the Long Dark. On midsummer night the ember bell rang once, though no hand pulled the rope.
castle.bishop.tale.2: The old books say the dwarf-smiths hung that bell so that it would speak if the Ember Forge was ever in danger. I fear the Forge is more than a story. I fear the creature that took the princess knows it.
castle.bishop.tale.3: I pray for Elowen each dawn, and I tell the queen old tales when her eyes are empty. But I pray most for you, smith. A fire that is lit in the right place, at the right time, is the oldest answer to the dark.
castle.bishop.title: Keeper of the Chapel Bells
castle.captain.name: Captain Edda
castle.captain.tale.1: Keep low behind the merlons when the wind turns, smith. From here I see every field to the Old Wood and every road to the horizon. Nine nights ago I saw nothing at all, and I cannot forgive myself for it.
castle.captain.tale.2: Wolves we know. Goblins we know. They come up the brook with torches and loud voices. This thing came with no sound and no light, over the walls and straight to the tower. It knew which window.
castle.captain.tale.3: If it knew the window, somebody told it, or somebody watched. I keep a list of names. It is short. I hate every name on it. I check the list each night, and I wish I had heroes to check the lands beyond.
castle.captain.title: Captain of the Watch
castle.chronicler.name: Chronicler Wynn
castle.chronicler.tale.1: I have written down this castle for forty years: weddings, wars, one famous pie. I always write the ending of a story last. I do not know the ending of this one, and the empty page beside my inkpot is very loud.
castle.chronicler.tale.2: The old records tell of the Long Dark. The dwarf-smiths let the Ember Forge go cold to hide it, and something older than the kingdom has hunted since for whoever can light it again. My guess is that Elowen carries the blood of the first Smith-Queen, and the creature knows it. A secret is a heavy gift, smith. Be careful with it.
castle.chronicler.title: Keeper of the Royal Archive
castle.falconer.name: Falconer Marn
castle.falconer.tale.1: My hawk Ash has flown these Vales for eleven years and never refused a command. On midsummer night she would not leave her perch. She screamed until dawn. Animals know things.
castle.falconer.tale.2: I sent my best hawks east to look for the princess. Three never came back. The fourth returned after a week, her feathers grey with ash and her eyes wild. She will not fly east again, and neither will I until I have a sword in my hand and a hero beside me.
castle.falconer.title: Master of the Royal Hawks
castle.far-spire.name: The Far Spire
castle.far-spire.tale.1: On a very clear day, far to the east past the mountain teeth, a thin dark tower stands at the edge of sight. The captain says it marks the land of Blackspire. The old maps say it was raised in one night, and that its lords serve a king nobody has seen.
castle.far-spire.tale.2: The smoke began only last spring. Perhaps a forge. Perhaps a fire. Perhaps a signal. The sentry says it points at the north tower, as straight as a finger. The captain says that is silly. Nobody has measured it.
castle.far-spire.title: A thread of smoke on the horizon
castle.founding-tapestry.name: The Founding Tapestry
castle.founding-tapestry.tale.1: It shows the first Smith-Queen at her anvil beneath the Ember Forge, with the dwarf-smiths bowing around her. Her hammer is stitched with real silver thread. She lit the Forge, and the Vales were safe for a thousand winters.
castle.founding-tapestry.tale.2: The bottom edge is torn. The missing strip once showed the end of the tale. The old queens say it was cut away on purpose. Some say it showed how the Forge would go cold again. Some say it showed how to light it a second time.
castle.founding-tapestry.title: Woven by the first queens
castle.jester.name: Pip the Fool
castle.jester.tale.1: Why is a smith like a good joke? Because she gets hit on the head and still comes out sharp! No? The queen laughed at that one once. Once, before. "Before" is a word I use a lot now.
castle.jester.tale.2: Fools see things because nobody watches fools. That night I was on the roof, because I like the stars, and I saw it leave. It was not a bird. It carried her like you carry a sleeping cat, carefully, because it wanted her alive. It flew toward the sunrise. East. I told the king, and he said fools lie. I do not lie about this.
castle.jester.title: Court Jester
castle.king.name: King Aldric the Patient
castle.king.tale.1: Welcome, smith. Do not kneel, because my knees hurt enough for both of us. Hollowbrook has been a quiet seat for my family. Two hundred years of wheat, wool and dull letters, and I loved every dull day of it.
castle.king.tale.2: Nine nights ago, at midsummer, my daughter Elowen was taken from the north tower. The door was barred from the inside. The window was broken outward. One guard heard a heavy wing, and then only silence.
castle.king.tale.3: I cannot leave the throne, because the Vales need a king who stands. My knights cannot leave the walls. But a smith who arms brave heroes can reach where my banners cannot. Forge well and send them far. Bring my daughter home, and the crown will not be the only thing I give you.
castle.king.title: King of the Vales
castle.knight-commander.name: Sir Berric the Grey
castle.knight-commander.tale.1: I held the north tower stair that night. Thirty years of service and I never lost a post. I heard the wing-beat, I drew my sword, and I climbed. The thing was already gone.
castle.knight-commander.tale.2: It left black feathers as long as my forearm. They were cold to the touch in midsummer, and they crumbled to ash by morning. Chronicler Wynn says no bird in these Vales has feathers like that.
castle.knight-commander.tale.3: My knights cannot chase it. If we leave the walls, the wolves and goblins of the Old Wood come out of the trees. So I train, I keep watch, and I wait for hands that are free to leave. Yours, smith, are the first I have seen that can arm such hands.
castle.knight-commander.title: Commander of the Royal Knights
castle.lamplighter.name: Old Bram
castle.lamplighter.tale.1: Seventy years I have lit the lamps on these walls, and I tell you, young one, the dark is not empty. It listens. In my grandfather's day we left a lamp in every window for the dwarf-smiths, and the dark kept its distance.
castle.lamplighter.tale.2: The mill down there stands by the brook, and the brook comes from the Old Wood. My mother said the Wood breathes. Since midsummer I swear it breathes in. Light a lamp for Elowen when you pass, and watch the shadows.
castle.lamplighter.title: Lamplighter of the Wall
castle.north-tower.name: The North Tower
castle.north-tower.tale.1: It is the tallest tower of the castle, and now it is kept locked. Elowen's chamber is at the top. She loved it because she could see her mother's window across the ward, and the fields beyond the walls.
castle.north-tower.tale.2: The window is broken, and every shard of glass fell outward into the ward. Whatever came did not come through the window. It left through it, with her. The door was still barred from the inside when the guards broke in.
castle.north-tower.tale.3: A white ribbon still hangs from the broken frame and moves in the wind. No one dares to take it down. The queen watches it every morning from across the ward. She says that as long as it moves, her daughter is not gone.
castle.north-tower.title: The princess's chamber
castle.old-wood.name: The Old Wood
castle.old-wood.tale.1: A dark green line at the edge of the farms. Woodcutters say the trees whisper after dusk. The goblin camps, the wolf trails and the hollow of the oldest tree are all in there. The Hollow Broodmother lives in that tree, and every spider in the wood is her child.
castle.old-wood.tale.2: Hollowbrook takes its name from the brook that comes out of a hollow in that wood. The farmers say that every fifth generation something old wakes there and sends the beasts out to the fields. Heroes who go in come out wiser, or do not come out.
castle.old-wood.title: Where the roots are older than the kingdom
castle.princess-portrait.name: Portrait of Princess Elowen
castle.princess-portrait.tale.1: She has her mother's hair and her father's stubborn chin, and she is not smiling, because the painter said a princess must not. She smiled the moment he left. The black ribbon on the corner of the frame was hung nine nights ago.
castle.princess-portrait.tale.2: Candles burn under it day and night. The servants take turns to keep them lit, even the ones who were never allowed to speak to her. A kitchen girl whispered that Elowen once brought her a honey cake every week for a year.
castle.princess-portrait.title: Painted in her sixteenth spring
castle.princess-throne.name: The Little Throne
castle.princess-throne.tale.1: A small throne of white oak, made when the princess was six, because she refused to sit on her father's lap during court. The seat is polished smooth by ten years of swinging feet.
castle.princess-throne.tale.2: Someone leaves a fresh flower on it every morning. Nobody admits to it. The cook says it is the king, the guards say it is the queen, and the queen says it is the jester. The jester says nothing, which is not like him.
castle.princess-throne.title: Empty since midsummer
castle.queen.name: Queen Isolde
castle.queen.tale.1: I have not slept since midsummer. I sit here because this is the last place I heard her laugh. She hid behind her little throne and jumped out at the bishop. He still tells the story, and now I cannot bear to hear it.
castle.queen.tale.2: Every dawn she tied a white ribbon to her window to say good morning to me across the ward. This is her spare ribbon. The other one still hangs from the broken window, and I cannot let anyone take it down.
castle.queen.tale.3: If your heroes walk into the hollow places of the world, tell them to listen. My daughter sings when she is afraid. She will sing, and she will not stop. She has a stubborn voice, my Elowen.
castle.queen.title: Mother of Elowen
castle.sentry.name: Archer Wat
castle.sentry.tale.1: Look down there! The golden squares are wheat, the brown ones are turned soil, and the little red roofs are the farmsteads. At harvest the whole valley shines like a fresh loaf. I count sheep when I cannot sleep, and none ever go missing. The goblins prefer chickens.
castle.sentry.tale.2: On clear evenings I see a thin black smoke far in the east, past the mountains. Just a thread. It was not there last spring. The captain says smoke is not a threat, but she also says I should stop looking at it. I do not stop.
castle.sentry.title: Sentry of the East Wall
castle.stained-window.name: The Forge Window
castle.stained-window.tale.1: The window shows the Ember Forge as it burned in the age of the dwarf-smiths: a golden fire in a blue night. The glass came from the same kilns as the first sword, so the light it throws on the floor never looks quite like daylight.
castle.stained-window.tale.2: The glazier signed the window on the right with a hammer. On the left he drew a tiny black bird, and nobody knows why. Since midsummer, the servants refuse to dust the left window.
castle.stained-window.title: Glass from the dwarf kilns
castle.steward.name: Steward Corwin
castle.steward.tale.1: Do not touch the ledger. Very well, touch it, but gently. The crown owns forty-one swords, nineteen shields and one very sad catapult that the old king bought from a traveller. The treasury is thin, because the fields no longer pay the full tithe.
castle.steward.tale.2: The farmers say wolves and goblins eat their harvests, and I cannot argue. When your heroes clear the Old Wood, the grateful coin comes to me, and I will turn it into more steel. I also keep a small ledger called "Elowen's Return". It is the only ledger that is not empty, because every servant adds a copper to it.
castle.steward.title: Keeper of the Royal Purse
castle.young-knight.name: Sir Tobin the Bold
castle.young-knight.tale.1: I was knighted two days before midsummer! Two days! And they sent me to guard the cellar door under the old inn, because the commander said a new knight should start with something safe. Nothing ever happens at that cellar door.
castle.young-knight.tale.2: I am sure the thing came from somewhere under Hollowbrook. That cellar has had a cold draught for ten years, and the rats there grow bigger every winter. I told the commander. He said, "Tobin, a draught is not evidence." I put a spear by the door anyway.
castle.young-knight.title: Newest Knight of the Realm
class.archer.name: Archer
class.archer.role: Ranged physical damage. Fast and accurate.
class.archmage.name: Archmage
class.archmage.role: Master of all spells. The strongest magic damage.
class.assassin.name: Assassin
class.assassin.role: Silent killer. Very high critical chance.
class.barbarian.name: Barbarian
class.barbarian.role: Two-handed melee brute. Huge damage, no shield.
class.berserker.name: Berserker
class.berserker.role: Reckless attacker. Trades Defence for raw damage.
class.brawler.name: Brawler
class.brawler.role: Street fighter. Hits hard and takes hits well.
class.champion.name: Champion
class.champion.role: Ring champion. Strong blows and tough body.
class.cleric.name: Cleric
class.cleric.role: Holy healer. Strong heals for the whole party.
class.deadeye.name: Deadeye
class.deadeye.role: One shot, one kill. Critical hits often.
class.disciple.name: Disciple
class.disciple.role: Trained in the fist arts. Very fast, precise strikes.
class.druid.name: Druid
class.druid.role: Nature healer. Heals over time and fights with wild magic.
class.fighter.name: Fighter
class.fighter.role: Bare-handed brawler. Knuckles in both hands, fast strikes.
class.grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
class.grandmaster.role: Master of the fist. Strikes many times in a row.
class.hunter.name: Hunter
class.hunter.role: Hunts big targets. Hits hard with every arrow.
class.knight.name: Knight
class.knight.role: Defensive front-liner. Holds the line with shield and heavy armour.
class.mage.name: Mage
class.marauder.name: Marauder
class.marauder.role: Raider with a huge axe. Even more damage, less Defence.
class.marshal.name: Marshal
class.marshal.role: Leads the line. Guards the whole party and never yields.
class.nightblade.name: Nightblade
class.nightblade.role: Strikes from the dark. Deadly first blow.
class.pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
class.pathfinder.role: Master of the wild. Never misses a mark.
class.priest.name: Priest
class.ranger.name: Ranger
class.ranger.role: Steady marksman. Strikes from far away with great accuracy.
class.ravager.name: Ravager
class.ravager.role: Wrecks all that stands in the way. Great damage and HP.
class.saint.name: Saint
class.saint.role: Blessed by the light. Heals fast and keeps allies alive.
class.shadowmaster.name: Shadowmaster
class.shadowmaster.role: Master of speed and shadow. Acts again and again.
class.sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
class.sorcerer.role: Burst caster. Strong spells that hit fast.
class.spirit-chieftain.name: Spirit Chieftain
class.spirit-chieftain.role: Chief of the tribe. Heals when it hits.
class.thief.name: Thief
class.thief.role: Very fast melee attacker with high critical chance.
class.totem-warrior.name: Totem Warrior
class.totem-warrior.role: Fights with the spirit of the wild. Strong and hard to kill.
class.trickster.name: Trickster
class.trickster.role: Quick and sly. Very fast and hard to hit.
class.voidcaller.name: Voidcaller
class.voidcaller.role: Calls the void. Spells that tear through armour.
class.warlock.name: Warlock
class.warlock.role: Dark caster. Spells that drain and wear down foes.
class.warlord.name: Warlord
class.warlord.role: Lord of battle. Every blow shakes the field.
class.warrior.name: Warrior
class.warrior.role: Front-line melee fighter with high HP and Defence.
class.wildwarden.name: Wildwarden
class.wildwarden.role: Guardian of the wild. Heals and fights well.
dungeon.goblin-camp.description: A crude camp of tents and fires. Goblin raiders guard it with their tame wolves.
dungeon.goblin-chief-lair.description: The den of the Goblin Chief. Take a second hero. The chief hits hard.
dungeon.old-wood-hollow.description: A hollow in the oldest part of the wood. Wolves and goblins fight over the territory.
dungeon.rat-cellar.description: Damp stone cellar under the old inn. Rats nest between the barrels and gnaw anything they find.
dungeon.scarecrow-field.description: A wheat field outside Hollowbrook. At night the scarecrows walk the rows, and the crows obey them.
dungeon.wolf-trail.description: A dark forest path where hungry wolves stalk travellers. Stray rats follow the packs for scraps.

log.title: Combat log
lore.prologue.1: Long ago, the dwarf-smiths of the Deep lit the Ember Forge and made the finest steel in the world. Then the Long Dark came. The forge went cold and the roads filled with beasts.
lore.prologue.2: You are a smith with a small shop in Hollowbrook and an old hammer from your teacher. Heroes come to you for steel, and you need the beasts they hunt for the materials.
lore.prologue.3: Hire heroes. Send them into the dark. Craft their gear. One day the forge will burn again.
lore.prologue.title: The Ember Forge
material.bone-shard.lore: A splinter of old bone. Light and hard.
material.coarse-sinew.lore: Dried sinew. It makes a strong bowstring.
material.copper-ore.lore: Green-streaked stone from the hills. Soft, but a good first metal.
material.faint-essence.lore: A glow that leaves a creature when it falls. Enchanters call it essence.
material.linen.lore: Rough cloth woven from flax. Every hero needs a shirt.
material.pine-wood.lore: Straight and light pine from the old wood. Smells of resin.
material.quartz.lore: A clear stone. Jewellers say it holds a little light.
material.rawhide.lore: Untreated hide. Tough once it is cured.
material.sharp-fang.lore: A fang still sharp enough to cut. Smiths set it into hilts.
material.tarnished-catalyst.lore: A dull charm of the dwarf-smiths. It helps good things happen in the forge.
merchant.hint: Selling takes time. Better goods take longer, up to 10 minutes. The merchant sells only a few goods at once.
monster.alpha-wolf.lore: The pack leader. It is old, grey and has beaten every challenger.
monster.bark-spider.lore: It hides in the old wood, grey as a tree trunk. You see it only when it is on your neck.
monster.cave-rat.lore: Big as a cat and twice as mean. They came up from the cellars when the grain ran low.
monster.goblin-captain.lore: A goblin who has lived long enough to learn tactics. It wears a stolen helm.
monster.goblin-chief.lore: He took the old wood with a rusty axe and a loud voice. His gold crown is a bucket.
monster.goblin.lore: Small, loud and sneaky. They steal what they cannot make and break what they cannot steal.
monster.harvest-king.lore: The first scarecrow of the field. Crows sit on its crown and the other scarecrows bow to it.
monster.hobgoblin.lore: Bigger and slower than a goblin. The Goblin Chief picks the strongest ones as his guards.
monster.hollow-broodmother.lore: She lives in the hollow of the oldest tree. Every spider in the wood is her child.
monster.rat-king.lore: Many rats grew together by their tails into one beast. It thinks like a crowd.
monster.straw-scarecrow.lore: Straw, rags and a stitched grin. It walks when nobody looks, and it keeps what it takes from the farms.
monster.wolf.lore: Thin from a hard winter, wolves now follow the roads and the people on them.

talk.castleBell: The ember bell in the chapel rang by itself at midsummer. My grandmother says that means trouble.
talk.castleOpen: The castle gate is open to any smith with good steel. The king, his knights and even the jester have stories to tell.
talk.clearedDungeon: They say the {dungeon} is quiet now, since the smith's heroes cleared it.
talk.companySize: You lead a company of {count}, and the old keeper says that is a fine start for a smith.
talk.dangerousDungeon: Nobody sleeps well near the {dungeon}, because the noise at night is terrible.
talk.emptyPurse: Coins are hard to find this season, so the smith must sell good steel to stay afloat.
talk.farmers: The farmers in the {region} fear the wolves more than the goblins.
talk.fullPurse: I heard the smith has a full purse, so maybe it is time to hire another hero.
talk.keep: The king in the castle says the Ember Forge will burn again, but I think he only wants his daughter back.
talk.marchingHero: I saw {hero} march toward the {dungeon} this morning, and I hope the road is safe.
talk.noHeroes: The tavern has no heroes at all. Someone should walk in and hire the first one.
talk.princess: They say the princess was taken from the north tower, and the guards whisper about black feathers.
talk.rats: The rats in the cellar grew bold this year, and they even stole my best cheese.
talk.smith: The smith at the workshop works hard, and with ore from the dungeons the forge will ring all day.
talk.southRoad: A trader said the south road leads to Barrowgate, and I would not walk it without good armour.
talk.tiredHero: {hero} looked tired after the last fight, so a warm meal at the tavern would help.
talk.townHistory: {town} has stood by this road for two hundred years, and the beasts never took it.
talk.unreadResults: Your hero came back from the {dungeon}, so go and read how the fight went.
tavern.hired: A new hero joins your company.
tavern.welcome: Welcome, traveller! Choose your first hero. The first hero is free. Pick a class and press Hire.
town.barrowgate.lore: The gate to the Barrow Downs. Mounds of the old kings line the hills, and the dead do not always rest.
town.blackspire.lore: A dark tower that was raised overnight. The lords inside serve a king nobody has seen.
town.deepdelve.lore: A dwarf mine town that was abandoned in the Long Dark. Some say the forge fires still glow below.
town.emberhold.lore: A fort of black stone at the foot of a volcano. Smiths love it for the heat. Everyone else fears the drakes.
town.frostmere.lore: A cold lake town in the far north. Its people trade furs for steel and tell tales of a giant under the ice.
town.highpass.lore: A fort in the high pass between the western lands and the east. Every army has crossed here, and every army left bones.
town.hollowbrook.lore: A quiet farm town on a brook that runs through a hollow. The old inn has a cellar that nobody likes to enter.
town.mirewatch.lore: A town on stilts above the marsh. The watchers there burn lamps all night against the fog and what walks in it.
town.sunscar.lore: A trade town in the burning desert, built among the ruins of a forgotten kingdom. The sand hides more than gold.
town.worldsend.lore: The edge of the map. Beyond the cliffs, the abyss burns, and the Ancient Wyrm sleeps on the first forge.
workshop.chooseCrafter: Choose a crafter. Each crafter has a level and makes one item at a time.
workshop.hint: Materials come from monster drops. A recipe uses materials of one tier only. Item level depends on your best hero.
